name: HeartLock
source:
Your friend's set you up on a blind date, where you meet a charming young women that seems kinda off,  but she's so nice!  She also seems really interested in you! Maybe you managed to find yourself a soulmate? What could've possibly go wrong after a one date right? The girls seems nice too! So everything will go as smooth as butter on bread! Maybe, you'll meet some more people along the way hm?

[From [url=https://donutworks.itch.io/heartlock]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的朋友给你安排了一次相亲，在那里你遇到了一位迷人的年轻女性，看起来有点不对劲，但她真的很好！她看起来也对你很感兴趣！也许你设法为自己找到了灵魂伴侣？一次约会之后可能会出现什么问题呢？看来妹子也不错啊！所以一切都会像面包上的黄油一样顺利！也许，一路上你会遇到更多的人，嗯？

[来自[url=https://donutworks.itch.io/heartlock]itch.io[/url]]
